Damage type Magic per live tooltip (hand-curated, no BIN type field). Left unchanged this loop (no error found).
_noteQ: Q (Snip Snip!) curated. GwenQ.mSpellCalculations: 'MiniSwipeDamage' (BaseDamage + StatByNamedDataValue APRatio, no mStat -> AP) and 'FinalSwipeDamage' (SwipeDamageBase + APRatio, same shape) are both plain, fully-supported GameCalculations. Wiki confirms Q always fires AT LEAST 2 snips (one mini snip + one final snip, matching the tooltip's 'Minimum Damage' = MiniSwipe(1)+FinalSwipe(1)) and consumes up to 4 'Snippy' stacks (from prior basic attacks/Q casts) to fire up to 4 EXTRA mini snips before the final one (tooltip 'Maximum Damage' = MiniSwipe*5+FinalSwipe, matching the BIN's own 'MaxDamage' aggregate calc, which sums MiniSwipeDamage*5+FinalSwipeDamage -- confirms the read but is a display aggregate, not curated as its own hit to avoid double-counting). Curated the GUARANTEED baseline only: MiniSwipeDamage(count 1) + FinalSwipeDamage(count 1) -- the extra 0-4 mini snips are Snippy-stack-count-dependent (a live buff-stack quantity this combo-damage model has no way to read), same category of omission as other stack-dependent variable-count skills in this codebase. NOT modeled: the wiki-documented 'center of each snip converts 50% of the damage to true damage' split (Physical/Magic/True mixing within one snip depending on hit position) -- no separate BIN calc exists for the true-damage portion (it's a script-side split of the same calc, not a distinct SpellCalculation name), so both hits are curated as pure Magic (the tooltip's non-center number) rather than force an invented True-damage hit.
_noteW: W (Hallowed Mist) confirmed damage-less. GwenW's only mSpellCalculation is 'TotalResists' (BaseResists + 0.07x-coefficient stat part) -- a self-only bonus-resistance grant for the zone Gwen stands in (matches wiki: summons a mist at her location that grants bonus armor/MR and immunity to attacks/damage from outside it; zero enemy-facing damage). Genuinely damage-less utility/self-buff skill -- slot omitted entirely per convention (not auto:true+reason).
_noteE: E (Skip 'n Slash) itself (the dash) deals no direct damage -- confirmed via wiki: 'Gwen dashes to the target location, then empowers her basic attacks within the next 4 seconds to deal 15 (+20% AP) bonus magic damage on-hit'. GwenE.mSpellCalculations 'OnHitDamage' = BaseDamage + StatByCoefficient(0.20, no mStat -> AP), matching the 15(+20%AP) tooltip exactly; 'BonusAttackSpeed' is a stat grant, not damage. Curated as a bonusEffects trigger:'onHit' (same shape as Warwick P Eternal Hunger) rather than a direct E hit, since the damage only lands via subsequent basic attacks, not the E cast itself.
_noteR: R (Needlework) is a 3-charge recast skill (initial cast = 1 needle, 1st recast = 3 needles, 2nd recast = 5 needles; wiki-confirmed '30/50/70(+10%AP)' per needle, second-cast/third-cast TOTALS match TotalDamage*3/TotalDamage*5). GwenR.mSpellCalculations: 'TotalDamage' (BaseDamage + StatByCoefficient 0.10 AP) is the single-needle formula; 'TotalDamage3'/'TotalDamage5' are GameCalculationModified referencing 'TotalDamage' with mMultiplier 3.0/5.0 (pre-multiplied per-cast TOTALS, not per-needle); 'MaxDamage' = TotalDamage x9 = 1+3+5 confirms these three sum to the full aggregate, so it is NOT curated as a 4th hit (would double-count). Modeled as three hits (one per real cast's already-totaled damage) inside a SINGLE R node rather than using 'castCount' (castCount assumes N IDENTICAL repeats of the same hit set, but Gwen's 3 casts are non-identical 1/3/5-needle bursts) -- functionally the same 'one node = full recast sequence' intent as Ahri R's castCount usage, just expressed as three distinct hits since the per-cast damage differs. Tagged 'BurstCeiling' (only slot tagged) as Gwen's single highest realistic combo-damage contribution across her kit.
